findings.problem: The prompt translates as 'la razón por la ___ vine', and 'que' fits just as well and is very common in Latin America ('por la que vine'); the hint does not rule it out, because 'que' also comes after la and has no accent.
findings.fix: hint: relative, after el/la/lo, no accent; not que

back.es: which (relative pronoun, used after el/la/lo/los/las: el cual, la cual, lo cual)
back.example: He arrived late, which bothered me a lot.

note: The prompt uses 'la cual' and the example uses 'lo cual', which nicely shows both patterns.
